# Synthetic playable portfolio clip

`portfolio.mp4` is a five-second, silent 180×320 H.264/yuv420p synthetic test pattern with fast-start metadata. It contains no customer, professional or provider media. It replaces on-runner video generation so slow OS package downloads cannot prevent browser assertions from starting. The existing profile, Discover/Story and Our Work tests still require real browser decoding, advancing playback, sound state and lifecycle behaviour. No assertion is removed.

Regenerate locally with FFmpeg:

```sh
ffmpeg -y -f lavfi -i testsrc2=s=180x320:d=5 -an -c:v libx264 -pix_fmt yuv420p -movflags +faststart tests/fixtures/media/portfolio.mp4
ffprobe -v error -show_entries stream=codec_name,width,height,pix_fmt -show_entries format=duration,size -of json tests/fixtures/media/portfolio.mp4
```

Review regenerated bytes and run browser decoding checks before committing an update. CI uses the tracked bytes directly and does not download an encoder or third-party clip.
